quarterly_data.quarter: Constellation Energy press release: Constellation and Amazon Announce 20-Year Power Purchase (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Calvert Cliffs expansion backed by the new Amazon agreement: the agreement will enable more than $3 billion in Maryland infrastructure investment, including improvements across the entire 1,790-megawatt Calvert Cliffs plant (Maryland's only nuclear plant) and approximately 190 megawatts in total of new generating capacity coming online between 2030 and 2032. Constellation says Amazon's long-term commitment will help provide the revenue certainty to relicense the plant for another 20 years and make progress toward developing new clean energy power plants at the site. CEO Joe Dominguez: the commitment 'creates a strong foundation for future investment in both the facility and in advanced nuclear technologies'.
quarterly_data.figure: more than $3 billion investment; 1,790-megawatt plant; approximately 190 megawatts of new capacity online between 2030 and 2032; relicense for another 20 years

connects_to.relationship: 20-year power purchase agreement - Calvert Cliffs nuclear output incl. 190 MW uprate, plus retail supply for Amazon operations in PJM

contracts.source: Constellation Energy press release: Constellation and Amazon Announce 20-Year Power Purchase (09-30-2026)
contracts.signal: Constellation and Amazon announced a 20-year agreement that includes 690 megawatts of power from the Calvert Cliffs Clean Energy Center, including the 190 megawatt uprate; the parties also entered into a related retail supply agreement to support Amazon operations in the 13-state PJM market. All electricity generated by Calvert Cliffs continues flowing to the PJM regional grid. Amazon (Kerry Person, VP of AWS Global Operations and Data Center Delivery) says the agreement sustains the plant's continued operation and expansion.
contracts.units: 690 megawatts of power, including the 190 megawatt uprate
